newsitem.title: CHINA: SOCCER-SHANGHAI REGAINS FORM TO BEAT SICHUAN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SHANGHAI REGAINS FORM TO BEAT SICHUAN.

text.p: Shanghai Shenhua ended a run of losses in Sunday's round of China's soccer league, beating hosts Sichuan Quanxing 3-1, the Xinhua news agency said in an overnight report.
Shanghai Shenhua, champions of the league in 1995, pulled ahead in the 16th minute after Shen Si scored from 20 metres out, Xinhua said.

The visitors stepped up the offensive despite a sell-out boisterous home crowd of 40,000, increasing their lead to 2-0 with a goal in the 52nd minute by Zhu Qi. Xie Hui took the score to 3-0 in the 63rd minute.
Sichuan Quanxing's Li Bing scored two minutes before the final whistle.
The win gave a boost to Shanghai Shenhua after three successive defeats, including a shock 1-9 loss to Beijing Guo'an.
Defending champions Dalian Wanda rallied from two goals down to draw with Yanbian Aodong 2-2.

In the day's other matches, Beijing Guo'an crushed Guangdong Hongyuan 4-1; Qingdao Hainiu was held to a 1-1 draw by August First, Vanguards Huandao routed Tianjin Samsung 3-1 and Jinan Taishan beat Guangzhou Apollo 1-0.
